description.zh:
告警事件是否自动恢复：

- true（默认）
- false
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically clear alert events. Default value: true. Valid values:

*   true
*   false
The description of the alert integration.
The name of the alert integration.

description.zh:
集成产品类型：

- CLOUD_MONITOR：云监控
- LOG_SERVICE：日志服务
description.en:
The service of the alert integration. Valid values:

*   CLOUD_MONITOR: CloudMonitor
*   LOG_SERVICE: Log Service

description.zh: 告警事件自动恢复时间，默认时间为300秒。
description.en: The period of time within which alert events are automatically cleared. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms create-integration --integration-name '云监控集成' --integration-product-type CLOUD_MONITOR --description '测试' --auto-recover true --recover-time 300 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms CreateIntegration --region cn-hangzhou --IntegrationName '云监控集成' --Description '测试' --AutoRecover true --IntegrationProductType CLOUD_MONITOR --RecoverTime 300 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
